frame.lots: min(4, 500000 // minimumCapital); >5L shown at 1 lot + gate

method: Deep tier: parquet legs re-priced at today's lot (NIFTY 65, SENSEX 20); charges.py leg_cost_calibrated on entry + exit of every leg (1 order each); 12M/3M by entry_date; MDD on net per-trade equity curve (exit order) at frame lots; Calmar = net/MDD.

Public tier: daily % compounded; Rs = % x lots x minimumCapital; charges = avgFrequency trades x lots x deep median charge/trade for mapped displayCategory structure (equity categories 0.1% of capital per trade; '--' frequency -> days traded).
Composite: gate-passers first, then 12M Calmar (deep if available else public) desc, PF tie-break.
Copier FIT = NIFTY + credit_spread/strangle + >=80% of trades are 2-leg same-expiry with a SELL.
